content: I released an LLM plugin for sending prompts to OpenAI's new Jev-clone decision model that's based on GPT-6 Luna https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/6/llm-openai-decisions/
Yes As @tunguz said once: “AI will humble all of us.”
We are entering a new era of discovery now: https://openai.com/index/sharing-ai-progress-in-mathematics/
what is your default/workhorse coding agent today, Oct 2026?

Every game is being decompiled Every math problem is being solved Everything is happening all at once Think about the progress in the past year Now imagine another year And another year The Halo OpenCE Experience™
Also, what a great video. Halo was my childhood and it's incredible to see all of these games decompiled. I'm pretty sure I downloaded The Strokes discography off Pirate Bay too 😂

After a brief but institution-eroding slop science era, it increasingly looks like we are going to have two revolutions from AI: 1) Everything ever published will be re-read and re-judged in ways that human scientists never anticipated 2) Novel discoveries will start to come fast

Context, OpenAI cracked or made important progress in hundreds of big problems today: https://openai.com/index/sharing-ai-progress-in-mathematics/ (And I am seeing rapid increases in the ability of AI to do novel work in my field of economic sociology, with nearly autonomous research getting to top journal level)

You will never achieve this level of aura. a KLM royal dutch airlines flight attendant wearing arctic survival gear and handling an armalite AR-10 battle rifle included in their emergency kits (1950s)
I am old enough to remember when we used humans to do Mathematics.
The craziest part is that we still mostly understand what is going on. That will not last for long.
